energy_model.incident_spectrum: dN/dE proportional to E^-2 over 1--100 GeV

interpretation: Generic compact-source abundance translation using the common incident-E^-2 calibration; calibrated only over the declared count, angular-speed, and luminosity support.

boundary_policy.poisson_upper_tail_central: retain fitted R=35 response for upward fluctuations of an in-range mean

support.outside_support: not evaluated or presented as calibrated

uncertainty.abundance_envelope: count-limit and local-density endpoints combined with the effective-volume marginal endpoints
uncertainty.effective_volume: 90% marginal interval from the joint injection, exposure-region, and velocity ensemble

local_density.description: A deliberately broad local-density range, sampled uniformly; 0.4 GeV cm^-3 is the central convention.
